name: The Faces of Love
source:
This was meant to be the start of something wonderful. A new chapter in your life, hand in hand with the woman you've come to love and cherish. Everything seemed to be going so well...

Unfortunately, it seems your wife has other plans for your wedding night.

[From [url=https://sokkamizuki.itch.io/the-faces-of-love]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这本来是美好事物的开始。与你所爱和珍惜的女人携手开启你人生的新篇章。一切似乎都进展得那么顺利……

不幸的是，你的妻子似乎对你的新婚之夜有其他计划。

[来自[url=https://sokkamizuki.itch.io/the-faces-of-love]itch.io[/url]]
